pairs.l: 1 — taught another subject at their school?
2 — never spoke their native language in class?

r1.exp: 1=B (Brigitte: 'we heard she was a DIFFERENT PERSON when she taught Italian' = predavala drugi predmet). 2=A (Aaron: teacher taught entirely in French, 'we never spoke our native language in front of him' applies to D, but A: 'taught our class entirely in French WITHOUT EXCEPTION'). 3=F (Frank: 'German grammar MUST BE TAUGHT THE OLD WAY'). 4=F (Frank: 'we'd discuss adjective agreement and many other things'). 5=B (Brigitte: 'if we'd completed our work successfully, she'd let us do word dominos or charades'). 6=A (Aaron: 'would even come in on SATURDAYS to work with us'). 7=E (Ella: 'give us sweets if we chose a BOOK on our own and handed in a REPORT'). 8=F (Frank: 'teacher emphasised MY MISTAKES rather than focusing on my progress'). 9=D (Daphne: 'we'd visit an exhibition occasionally, or go collect plants'). 10=A (Aaron: 'when I later became FLUENT in French, I knew I had mostly him to thank'). 11=E (Ella: 'obviously, she didn't have a clue about TEACHING HIGH SCHOOL STUDENTS' = previously taught university). 12=C (Carl: 'he entered a FOREIGN EXCHANGE PROGRAMME FOR TEACHERS').

r13.exp: 'My shoe SPONSORS WOULD KILL ME if I was pictured without them' = obveza prema sponzorima = C (she has to wear them).

r14.exp: 'One day Ricky SAW ME QUARREL IN A BAR' = slučajni susret = B (by chance). Farah sama kaže: 'you can put it down to COINCIDENCE'.

r15.exp: 'CLOSE TO MY BROADWAY VENTURES' = slično nedavnom brodwayskom radu = A.

r16.exp: 'I WOULD BE DISAPPOINTED IF SHE DIDN'T WIN' = trebala bi pobijediti = C (should win). Nije sigurno, ali zaslužuje.

r17.exp: 'Has to be seen as a reward for ARTISTIC VALUE' = odražavati filmsku kvalitetu = B.

r18.exp: 'The only question: whether it is too FANCIFUL. Characters are based on real characters... passionate, driven, forever in conflict.' = psihološka drama = C.

r19.exp: 'Well-drilled squad of super-teens. (19)___. Almost all will be BBGs at Wimbledon.' → E: They are among the survivors of a rigorous process that has reduced around 1,000 applicants to an elite core of 250.

r20.exp: 'Fitness, discipline, knowledge. (20)___. Then must stand stock-still for three minutes.' → A: All training sessions begin with the standard warm-up: a circuit of fitness exercises that I, apparently, can't do.

r21.exp: 'Must use precise techniques for rolling/feeding/receiving. (21)___. They must also judge scores, march in file...' → G: It is not enough just to get the ball where it needs to be.

r22.exp: 'They sit written exams. (22)___. However, still not guaranteed a place.' → C: Those who pass go on to train in simulated matches.

r23.exp: 'Assessments add stress. (23)___. Fail to spot a point and careless BBG becomes centre of attention.' → H: If a BBG makes a mistake, the result is almost always disastrously high-profile.

r24.exp: 'Hayley knows all about high-speed shots. (24)___. Every BBG can tell you that story.' → D: She tells me she was once hit by a ball at over 100mph.

r25.exp: 'The beach is OVERLOOKED by the National Trust's holiday cottage' — 'overlook' = gledati odozgo, dominirati nad (kuća gleda na plažu).

r26.exp: 'See ACROSS the sea to West Wales' — 'across' = s jedne strane na drugu (pogled koji prelazi more).

r27.exp: 'A NUMBER of rare insects' — 'a number of' uz brojivu imenicu množine (insects, plants, birds = brojivo).

r28.exp: 'Shaped by farming SINCE the Stone Age' — 'since' za trajan period koji seže do sadašnjosti (has been shaped = present perfect).

r29.exp: 'Rhossili Bay HAS BEEN ACKNOWLEDGED' — present perfect passive (plaža je prepoznata = nagrada je nedavna).

r30.exp: 'Enjoy ITS outstanding natural beauty' — posvojna zamjenica 'its' za mjesta/imenice (Rhossili Bay's beauty).

r31.exp: 'Recognise the best beaches ACCORDING TO the people that really matter' — 'according to' = prema, po mišljenju.

r32.exp: 'THE OTHER two British resorts' — 'the other' za ostatak od poznate grupe (Rhossili Bay + the other two = three total from the UK).

r33.exp: 'More common in culturally diverse areas, WHERE there is a wider audience' — relativna priložna zamjenica 'where' (u mjestima gdje).

r34.exp: 'Rather THAN flavour' — fiksni izraz: rather than = umjesto, a ne.

r35.exp: 'Along WITH some cities in America' — fiksna kolokacija: along with = zajedno s, kao i.

r36.exp: 'Differ FROM each other' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: differ from = razlikovati se od.

r37.exp: 'Result IN astonishing dishes' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: result in = rezultirati nečime.

r38.exp: 'Much LESS so' — 'less so' = manje uspješni (elipsa: much less so = much less successful).

r39.exp: 'Difficult to pull OFF' — frazalni glagol: pull off = uspjeti u nečemu teškom, izvesti.

r40.exp: 'WHILE/WHEREAS good fusion cuisine combines ingredients well, confusion cuisine throws them together' — 'while/whereas' za kontrast između dviju surečenica.

sol.rubric: Esej 200-250 riječi. ZA: neovisnost, nova iskustva, strane kulture/jezici, osobni razvoj. PROTIV: nedostatak potpore obitelji, usamljenost, skupo, gubitak korijena. Vlastito mišljenje.

w1.exp: Esej — ručno se ocjenjuje. Diskusijski esej (discuss both views + opinion). Viša razina: akademski stil, 200–250 riječi.
